# Sailing Home Sarasota

> A book by Jan Hamel Solomon: a little girl's riveting journey from the sandy white beaches of Sarasota to the far reaches of planet earth. Coming soon to Amazon.

- Author: Jan Hamel Solomon, international educator, Christian relief worker, and owner of Key Sailing Charters in Sarasota, Florida, with her husband, Captain Tim Solomon.
- Get a copy or book Jan to speak: sailinghomesarasota@gmail.com, (941) 346-7245, or the forms on this site.
